emma_new: Hi all, newbie here. Trying the quickstart and I keep hitting 429s. I used the REDWOOD_API_KEY from the setup email. Is that a hosted key or sandbox? :grimacing:

claire_devex: Welcome Emma! :tada: That onboarding key is a sandbox key by default. Sandbox has lower QPS and a daily token cap to prevent abuse. Hosted keys require a billing profile.

emma_new: Got it. I ran `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/outputs` and saw `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0` and `x-ratelimit-reset: 20`. My script does a lot of short requests to demo streaming. Is there a console page that shows limits?

vince_infra: Console -> Usage -> API keys shows per-key windows and daily usage. The response headers are authoritative for short-term rate windows. Sandbox default is usually around 5-10 rps per key depending on cohort.

emma_new: Ah, that explains it. For a demo tomorrow I need ~30rps for 8 minutes. Is there a simple way to request a temporary bump?

claire_devex: Yep. We can grant short demo boosts. Please DM me or post the template to create an ops ticket: `key_id, 2026-07-10T18:00Z -> 2026-07-10T18:08Z, 30rps, demo streaming feature.` Devex-bot can also auto-create the request if you post the template here.

devex-bot: Demo boost template accepted format: `key_id, start_utc -> end_utc, expected_rps, reason`. Example: `emma-sandbox-1, 2026-07-10T18:00Z -> 2026-07-10T18:08Z, 30rps, product walkthrough`

emma_new: Thanks! Quick follow-up: do sandbox keys count against the org? I don't want to accidentally block others during tests.

vince_infra: Sandbox keys are per-user and isolated from hosted account capacity. Hosted/billed keys are account-level. If you need team-wide testing we can provision a separate demo sandbox for the team.

emma_new: One more thing 609 I saw both `x-ratelimit-*` headers and an `x-quota-daily-remaining` header. Which one matters right now?

claire_devex: Short-term throttles are controlled by `x-ratelimit-limit`, `x-ratelimit-remaining`, `x-ratelimit-reset` (requests/sec windows). `x-quota-daily-remaining` is your daily token budget. You can hit either independently; the short-term 429s you saw are from the rate window.

security-bot: Reminder: if you accidentally commit your key anywhere, revoke and rotate immediately. See internal playbook: https://intranet.redwood.ai/security/keys.

emma_new: Thanks everyone 44d I'll DM the template and throttle my local script. Also switching to a single stream for the demo per the advice. Appreciate it!
